dashboard.label: IPMI Overview
dashboard.description: Live BMC health from ipmitool: sensor readings, chassis/BMC status, and the System Event Log (SEL)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ipmi:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen" latest(chassis_system_power_state) as "System Power" latest(chassis_last_power_event) as "Last Power Event" latest(chassis_power_restore_policy) as "Restore Policy" latest(bmc_firmware) as "BMC Firmware" by host

| mstats avg("ipmi.*") as "r*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=1h | foreach r* [eval Reading=coalesce(Reading,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - r* | table _time metric_name Reading | rename metric_name as Metric | sort Metric
index=main sourcetype="ipmi:sel" | sort - _time | table _time host sel_record_id sel_sensor sel_type sel_assertion sel_data | head 200
